title: Client PANs not available at a KRA (NSE ENIT)
purpose: The file <TMcode>_KRA_NOT_AVAILABLE on NSE's member portal (ENIT > Log > Downloads): the firm's client PANs not uploaded to any KRA. None of the exchanges' or the depository's circulars gives the file's columns: they are read by their header names, which this layout lists (add a header text here when the file's differs). The file is matched by PAN, then the client code.
linked: Matched with the clients on Compliance → KYC trading gate: each client on it is held back on the front ends until the KRA verifies the KYC and a later list no longer has the client.
source: NSE/ISC/77375 (circular 50/2026), para 2. The columns are not published: read by header names.
